public.nav.label: Public information
public.interfaceFallback: The interface is shown in English while this language is being prepared. Published information uses the selected language when a reviewed version is available.
public.footer: Reviewed public information for Calais. Confirm time-sensitive details with the provider.
public.footer.disclaimer: InfoKit provides reviewed information and referrals only. It does not make eligibility or legal decisions.
public.fallback: Reviewed content in {language} is shown because this item is not yet published in your language.
basics.title: Basic information
basics.description: Emergency numbers, and where to start if you have just arrived.
basics.emergencyBody: These numbers are free from any phone, with no credit and no SIM card, day and night. Ask for an interpreter if you need one.
basics.number.emergencyHint: One number for police, ambulance and fire, everywhere in Europe.
basics.number.ambulanceHint: A doctor answers: injury, illness, pregnancy, overdose.
basics.number.policeHint: Violence, danger, theft, or someone threatening you.
basics.number.fireHint: Fire, accident, rescue, or someone trapped.
basics.number.shelterHint: Somewhere to sleep tonight, and emergency social help.
basics.number.deafHint: Written help by SMS: do not call this number, text it.
basics.waterHint: Free water points and shower times near you.
basics.newHereBody: Start with what matters in the first days: where to eat, wash, see a doctor and get advice, one step at a time.
activities.title: Activities and services
activities.description: Filter reviewed public activities, compare essential details, or use the low-data map to see where exact public locations are.
activities.freshnessNotice: Times change quickly. Every card says how long ago it was last verified — confirm before travelling.
activities.search: Search by activity, need, place or provider
activities.empty: No published activities match these filters.
activities.mapHint: Pins show relative positions for places approved for exact public display.
activities.noMap: None of these activities has an exact public map location.
activities.location.privacy: Your location is used only on this screen to position the map. It is not saved, sent to InfoKit or included in analytics.
activities.location.found: Your location is shown on the map.
activities.location.denied: Location permission was not granted. The full activity list remains available.
activities.location.unavailable: Location is not available on this device. The full activity list remains available.
activities.location.error: Your location could not be found. Try again or use the activity list.
activities.contactForPlace: Contact the provider for the location
activities.confirmSchedule: Confirm the current time with the provider
organization.activitiesEmpty: Nothing they run is published yet. Their profile is here so you know who they are.
articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Read dated, reviewed information with clear ownership and warnings when details may no longer be reliable.
articles.empty: No articles are published in this language yet.
articles.unreliable: Check before relying on this information
events.title: Events
events.description: One-off moments open to everyone, announced by the organisations that run them: what is happening, when, where, and who to ask.
events.occasional: An event is occasional: a special day, a gathering, a celebration. The services that run every week — meals, showers, drop-ins — are listed under activities.
events.empty: No public events are announced right now.
events.checkBefore: Confirm the time with the organiser before travelling.
simulator.title: Information simulator
simulator.description: Choose a reviewed information path. Questions are optional and your answers are never stored or linked to you.
simulator.empty: No simulator paths are published yet.
simulator.privacy: Your answers remain only in this browser screen and disappear when you start again or close it.
